tei:div.tei:p: rtsom pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/

karma pa rang byung rdo rje ni la stod lho'i char rje btsun mi la'i 'khrungs yul dang nye ba'i mang yul gung thang tsa phur/ lan de gangs zhur mo zhes pa'i 'gram du yab sngags kyi ston pa chos dpal dang*/ yum jo mo g.yang 'dren gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung lnga pa'i shing sprel zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad spyi lo ( 1284 ) la sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo lngar son pa na grub chen o rgyan pas karma pa'i sku skyer ngos 'dzin gnang ste rjes su bzung nas dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang sems bskyed/ bde mchog /dgyes rdor/ dus 'khor sogs kyi dbang dang rgyud bshad/ gzhan yang sku gsum ngo sprod dang*/ bsre 'pho sogs man ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa gnang*/ dgung lo bdun pa lcags stag la/ khro phu mkhan po kun ldan shes rab las rab tu byung ste 'dul ba'i bslab bya mtha' dag la byang chub par mdzad/ de nas grub chen gnyan ras kyis mtshur phur gdan zhus bzhin phebs nas/ slob dpon shes rab dpal dang*/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od/ gnam mtsho ba sogs la rim bzhin sdud 'grel pañci ka'i bshad sbyar dang*/ dgyes rdor/ spyod 'jug sogs zab chos ci rigs gsan/ grub chen gnyan ras pa'i mdun mar mi dwags gsum nas brgyud pa'i kaṃ tshang gi zab chos mtha' dag dang*/ rngog mtshur mes gsum ras chung pa sogs nas brgyud pa'i gdams khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan/ de nas gsang phu gling smad kyi gdan rabs bco lnga pa 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu'i mdun byams chos sde lnga dang*/ dbu ma rtsa ba/ dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum gyi gzhung dang*/ tshad ma sde bdun yan lag dang bcas pa/ mngon pa gong 'og sa sde sogs 'grel ba dang bcas pa gzhung mtha' dag la gsan bsam dpyis phyin par gnang*/ dgung lo nyi shu pa lcags glang la tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan rabs lnga pa gnas brtan gzhon nu byang chub kyis mkhan po dang*/ dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs/

mtshan tshul khrims gzhon nu zhes gsol/ mkhan po de nyid las 'dul ba lung sde bzhi mdo rtsa sogs 'dul ba'i gzhung rnams thugs su chub par gsan/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub las dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ sbyor drug gi gdams khrid/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ 'khor lo sdom pa/ gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ gdan bzhi dang rdo rje gur saṃ bhu ṭa/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa bcas dbang rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa/ gsang snying dang*/ phur pa bka' brgyad kyi dbang yongs rdzogs/ de nyid 'dus pa dang dpal mchog rigs bsdus sogs sbyong rgyud kyi dkyil chog rnams dang*/ gtsug dgu dang rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sogs rgyud sde gong 'og rnams kyi dbang bka' rgyud 'grel sgrub thabs phal cher dang*/ sa sde lnga dang mngon pa gong 'og dkon mchog brtsegs pa sogs mdo sde mang po dang*/ snyan ngag me long ma/ zhi byed dang*/ lam 'bras/ sbyong drug /o rgyan pa'i bsnyen sgrub bcas gdams pa mtha' dag dang*/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi lung sogs rdzogs par gsan/ mkhas pa rba ras sogs la gso ba rig pa'i skor dang*/ skar rtsis sogs gsan te rtsis kyi sa ris kho nar sbyang pa'ang lcags smyug bdun zad par grags/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims rin chen las/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud 'grel dang*/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ ma hā ma ya/ gur dang*/ gdan bzhi/ mes rngog rnam gnyis las brgyud pa'i dgyes rdor gyi rgyud rgya gzhung 'grel pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gshed skor dang*/ bde mchog snyan brgyud sogs mar rngog las brgyud pa'i gdams ngag sgrub yig bka' lung dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma ku mā ra dza'i mdun rdzogs chen snying thig gsan te karma'i yang dben du nyams bzhes gnang skabs bi ma la rang gi mdzod spur thims pa'i gzigs snang shar te karma snying thig gi shing rta'i srol phyes/

dbus gtsang dwags kong*/ tsā ri dang khams phyogs rnams su phebs te de phyogs kyi skye bo dpag tu med par gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i dpal la 'god par mdzad/ dgung lo zhe drug pa bod rab byung drug pa'i lcags lug ( 1331 ) la/ yon gong ma tho gan the mur gyis gdan zhus lan grangs du ma byung ste/ chu sprel ( 1332 ) la mtshur phu nas bteg ste mtsho sngon sogs kyi lam brgyud nas phebs te yon gong ma 'khor dang bcas pa chos kyis smin par mdzad de lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ de nas shing khyi spyi lo ( 1334 ) la bod du phyir phebs te bsam yas mchims phu sogs su ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ de rjes bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs te rab tu gnas par mdzad/ slar yang me byi ( 1336 ) la pe cing du phebs te pe cing nub tu dgon pa zhig gsar bzhengs gnang te dgung grangs lnga bcu nga drug pa sa yos spyi lo ( 1339 ) la zhi bar gshegs/ sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus te gdung rten rnams mtshur phur gdan 'dren zhus te gdung rten du bzhugs su gsol ba'o/ /khong gi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni grub brnyes kyi go 'phang la dbang 'byor zhing zung 'jug gi rgyal sar bzhugs pa g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ zhwa dmar sku phreng dang po rtogs ldan grags pa seṅge/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ tshal pa si tu/ dol bu pa shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs gangs ri'i ljongs dang rgya hor gyi yul gru kun tu phyag rgya chen po la dbang 'byor zhing byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan cing rig gnas kun la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa mang du byon no// // dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang thub bstan 'od zer pas/ rtsom po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/rtsom po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ - PAGE 4 -- PAGE 3 -- PAGE 1 -
